name: cflocation
description: Redirect the current request to another URL.

params.name: url
params.description: The URL of the HTML file or CFML page to open.

params.name: addToken
params.description:
Yes or No. clientManagement must be enabled, see cfapplication. Yes appends client variable
information to the URL you specify in the url.

params.name: abort
params.description:
if set to true then the request will be aborted instead of redirected to allow developers
		to troubleshoot code that contains redirects

params.name: statusCode
params.description: statuscode used for the redirect (301 or 302)

params.name: encode
params.description: Encode the given URL value (changed behavior in Lucee 6.0)
